mezzconfig:
MezzConfig is a lightweight configuration library for Minecraft mods on Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge. It gives mod developers one API for managing client preferences, settings for individual worlds and servers, and server-controlled options synchronized to connected players.

Features include:

- Different config types: shared client preferences, per-world or per-server client settings, and server-owned configuration.
- Modpack defaults: pack authors can provide defaults while allowing players and worlds to override individual settings.
- Validated configuration: built-in support for numbers, text, colors, enums, lists, and custom value types.
- Responsive updates: change listeners and restart requirements let mods apply settings at the right time.
- Automatically detect file updates: changes to config files are applied in-game.
- Migration and recovery: tools to preserve existing setting

 Restore the selection indicator!

Simple mod that collects anonymous player count metrics for modpack authors, sends it to a centralized web server, and stores it in InfluxDB for easy Grafana viewing of historical data:

 

This mod integrates with Better Compatibility Checker and will use the version number from your BCC config if possible.

Metrics endpoint URL is configurable, as well as pack ID and the rate at which keepalive requests should be sent.

Resistance Balancer

 For Minecraft 1.17-1.21.1 

Requires Necronomicon API and Fabric API. 
Requires Connector for (Neo)Forge.

 Lightweight, serverside mod that allows to define a custom formula to calculate damage reduction from the resistance effect. It also allows to add a simple reduction too, for example 5% damage reduction per level. 

 The reason behind this? 

 While Resistance is really good in vanilla, it's an effect used by a lot of mods, which by default is really strong. This mod allows modpack developers to have freedom on what resistance really is for them. Want to make it weaker? Go ahead. Stronger? I won't judge.

noblind:
NoBlind

 NoBlind is a lightweight client-side mod that completely removes the screen overlays and fog distortion caused by the blindness and darkness status effects.

 What does it do?

In vanilla Minecraft, the Blindness and Darkness effects severely restrict your vision by rendering a thick fog circle or pulsing the screen to total blackness. This mod stops the client from rendering those specific visual overlays, keeping your screen clear.

NoBlind removes:
- The thick, near-sight fog circle caused by the Blindness effect.
- The pulsing screen-dimming overlay caused by the Darkness effect in the Deep Dark.

NoBlind keeps:
- The actual status effects on the server side (e.g., you still cannot sprint while blinded).
- All other vanilla fog behaviors (like normal biome fog or render distance limits).

Description 
BlockOffensive that brings classic Counter-Strike gameplay into the world of Minecraft. It delivers a full tactical FPS experience, featuring team-based combat between Counter-Terrorists (CT) and Terrorists (T), bomb planting and defusing mechanics, a weapon shop system, and round-based match mode.

Built on the FPSMatch framework, the mod incorporates a modern user interface and includes an economy system, specialized equipment (such as C4 bombs and defuse kits), a voting system, MVP awards, and team-switching functionality. By maintaining compatibility with weapon mods like TACZ (Timeless and Classics Zero), BlockOffensive offers an authentic tactical shooting experience that blends the creativity of the block-based world with the thrill of competitive FPS.

友谊模组是一个为 MC 多人游玩设计的关系成长模组。

它不会强迫你组队、打卡或刷任务，而是让这个世界记住你和朋友之间真实发生过的事：你们一起待了多久，互相做过哪些互动，谁送过花，谁把谁踹飞，谁又在濒死的时候被朋友拉了一把……

如果你有固定一起玩的朋友，这个模组会让你们的关系在存档里一点点长出来。

 🌱 如何开始

先摘一朵花，送给你的朋友。💐

按 Z 打开友谊面板，你可以查看附近玩家、处理好友关系、查看今天的互动记录和你们留下的回忆。新玩家第一次接触模组时，也会有简单的教程引导，不需要先读一大堆配置说明。

建立关系之后，你们只要正常一起玩就会逐渐积累友谊值。待在 30 格（可配置）以内、同一个世界，友谊就会慢慢增长。每天有成长上限，所以它更鼓励长期陪伴，而不是一口气刷满。

 🎮 这个模组会带来什么

 🔥 关系会成长

朋友之间有 7 个火花等级。等级越高，解锁的互动越多：从最开始的摸头、送花，到后面的传送、扛起朋友甚至将他甩飞出去、灵魂互通和濒死救援。

这些能力不是为了让你变强，而是为了让你们有更多能一起制造回忆的瞬间。

 🫶 日常互动有反馈

空手右键朋友可以摸头，手持花可以送花，手持食物可以喂食。它们不一定给强力 buff，但会有粒子、声音、动画和记录反馈。🤚💐🍖

你也可以用 Z 对朋友发动恶作剧踢，把他一脚踢飞；潜行加 Z 可以把朋友扛起来，扛着时按 X 可以把他甩出去。🦶🏋️🚀

 🌟 不管你在哪，我来了

达到 2级火花后，可以使用传送能力。按 Shift + X 读条 3 秒，传送到在线朋友身边。它不限制距离，也不限制维度，但有冷却时间。

这不是传统意义上的传送点系统，而是一个很直接的多人体验：朋友需要你，你就过去。

 💞 灵魂互通

3级火花解锁灵魂互通。

对准朋友按 X ，两个人会进入连接状态。连接期间，你们的生命变化会被绑定在一起，并且可以切换到对方视角进行移动和攻击操作。任何一方都可以主动断开。

safe-respawn:
Safe Respawn

 
 

Normally, hostile Minecraft mobs will only despawn when the player is very far away. This can cause problems if the player encounters a horde of mobs near their spawnpoint, which can trap them in an endless death loop with the same mobs.

This mod changes the entity logic to allow mobs to despawn if there is no living player nearby. This way, when a player dies, they will respawn without any hostile mobs around them (provided there are no other players in the area).

 This is similar to behavior that occurs on PaperMC servers, possibly due to their "delay-chunk-unloads-by" implementation.
 
This change could break some obscure types of mob farms which make use of nether or end portals, but I've tried to make sure that isn't the case! Please report an issue if you find any unintended consequences.

TravelBag

TravelBag is a free and reliable backpack mod for Fabric with configurable sizes, optional LuckPerms support, smart file-based storage, and a built-in shortcut item for quick access.

It is designed to feel safe on real servers:
- Each player has their own stored TravelBag
- The storage format always keeps room for 6 rows internally
- Downgrading permissions or config size does not delete hidden items
- Backups are created safely without generating nested backup files
- The latest 2 backups are rotated automatically per player file
- Item data is serialized with registry-aware codecs so enchantments and other components stay intact
- Unsafe bag data is locked instead of being silently overwritten
- No client-side mod needed

- Configurable TravelBag size from 1 to 6 rows
- Optional LuckPerms integration for size and feature permissions

/cif 
 

- range : The search radius in blocks (integer)

 Results

ArbiterLib ⚙️

 Arbiter is a Minecraft datapack framework library, your tool for quicker implementation of things you wish to make. It makes things easier for those who wish to use it!

It is recommended to follow this project (❤️) or join the Discord to receive updates about the latest versions (which are always required)!

 What it has to offer

- Crafting: a workbench and a smeltery, mimicking vanilla blocks.
 - JEI Integration for all Arbiter recipes and items via ArbiterJEI 

- Commands for quick actions like applying y-motion, quick heads, instakills, etc.

- Block registry and centralized ticks. Placement logic and removal handled by Arbiter!

Flashback Export Extras 
 
 Flashback Export Extras is a Fabric add-on that extends Flashback's Minecraft replay export features.
 
 
 Features

- Export depth maps.
- Export multi-layer OpenEXR files containing color and Depth.Z channels.

NoBob
NoBob brings back the classic view-bobbing tweak to modern Minecraft!

Clean up your in-game camera by stripping away the constant screen shaking and sway when walking, while still keeping a subtle animation when you begin moving.

 A Little Piece of Minecraft History: 
 "NoBob" was a popular visual tweak in the earlier(ish) days of Minecraft Modding and (probably) made its first appearance around 2012. Over the years, the feature has gotten rarer and rarer to find. This mod brings that original behavior back to modern Minecraft.

 Why Not Just Disable View Bobbing in Vanilla?
The answer is simple: keeping the subtle animation makes Minecraft feel more fluid and responsive while eliminating the aggressive sway that causes motion sickness.

 Why Use This Mod?
If you dislike vanilla view bobbing but hate how static and lifeless the screen feels with it toggled off, NoBob is the ideal

It is specifically designed to breathe new life into legacy and low-end hardware, targeting computers from around the 2010 era. The main goal of the modification is to radically increase frame rates (FPS) in demanding scenarios without sacrificing visual comfort.

Key Features and Technologies:

 Proprietary AS Upscaling: The mod uses an advanced spatial scaling technology. The complex 3D world of the game is rendered at a lower resolution, instantly removing heavy loads from weak graphics cards. It is made of two parts:

- a Velocity plugin that decides which login server and destination backend a player should use
- a client mod that appends a pack identifier to the Minecraft handshake before backend selection happens

Description
 ServerBackupFabric is a Minecraft mod designed to automate and simplify the process of creating and managing backups for your Minecraft server. It allows server administrators to create manual and automatic backups of the world, restore backups, and even restore individual player inventories. The mod ensures that your server data is safe and easily recoverable in case of unexpected issues.

---
 Features
- Manual backups : Create backups of your server world on demand.
- Automatic backups : Schedule periodic backups to ensure your data is always protected.
- Backup Management : Automatically limit the number of backups to save disk space.
- Restore World : Restore the entire server world from a backup.
- Restore Player Inventory : Restore individual player inventories from backups.
- Backup Suggestions : Autocomplete suggestions for backup IDs and online players in commands.

 Enchancement, which completely overhauls enchanting and a lot of various game mechanics.

 Respawnable Pets, which adds a way to make pets a more permanent addition to your playthrough.

 Lost Relics, which adds powerful artifacts in ancient structures around the world.
 Anthropophagy. which adds a (dubious) alternative source of food.

Official modpack for the Magic & Machinery Server 

This modpack aims to bring technology of the Edwardian era to Minecraft. At the core of this pack, the Create mod allows players to design and build all sorts of functional machinery. Expanding upon this notion, addons like Crafts and Additions, Steam n' Rails, and Farmer's Delight bring more ways to use energy and machinery. While one player may be pushing the industrial revolution along, another may focus on more... War related pursuits. The Create: Big Cannons mod, and various other combat and war tech themed mods provide a contrasting playstyle. Both paths converge when it comes to controlling "molten vents" that function as infinite resource nodes for ores that are not typically infinite.

vanilla-friendly-invisible-minecarts:
This resourcepack aims to make invisible minecarts a possibility without relying on destructive methods that are a pain to remove.

- Unlike other methods that makes minecarts invisible, this one is completely reversible , meaning once you disable the resourcepack, you won't be left with any weird artifacts like command blocks in your minecarts. 

- The provided datapack is completely optional! , you can integrate it directly into your datapack or simply use command blocks instead.

​

With the provided datapack, making a minecart invisible is as simple as giving it a tag.

 
tag @n[type=minecart] add InvisibleMinecart
 
If you want to summon one, you can use this command instead

 
summon minecart ~ ~ ~ {Rotation:[24F,24F],Tags:["InvisibleMinecart"]}
 

​

Without the datapack, you'll need to manually rotate minecarts 24 degrees in each axis.

 
rotate @n[type=minecart] 24 24
 
This com

notooexpensive:
Removes the "Too Expensive!" anvil limit. Any operation goes through regardless of cost, and the repair penalty on the output item is reset each time so it never builds up again.

 Features
- Removes the "Too Expensive!" block on all anvil operations
- Resets the repair cost on output items so the problem does not come back
- No commands, no config, no permissions to set up
- Tiny footprint, just a single event listener running in the background

 How it works

Vanilla blocks any anvil result with a cost of 40 levels or more. NoTooExpensive listens for the anvil calculation event, detects when the cost hits that threshold, and allows the result through anyway. It also zeroes out the repair penalty on the output item so it stays usable long term.

activityroles:
ActivityRoles

ActivityRoles is a simple plugin that allows you to grant players roles in your Discord server based on their in-game play time.

This plugin uses DiscordSRV as the linking system between your Minecraft server and Discord server, so make sure that you have it installed and setup using the linking.yml file in DiscordSRV's configuration.

There are two types of syncs:

- Giving a player a role based on how long they have ever played on the server. (type: "total")
- Giving a player a role based on how recently they have played on the server. (type: "seen")

You can list times in either minutes, hours, days, or weeks, by using "m", "h", "d", or "w"

NOTE: Offline players will only have their "seen" roles synced, they must be online to have their "total" role synced. This is a MC limitation.

💧 How Thirst Works

- Every player has a water level , from nothing up to the maximum set in the configuration. The current level is shown on screen at all times through the water bar.
- Water drains slowly over time — once every ten seconds. How much is lost depends on where the player is and what they are doing:
 - Hot places drain water much faster, cold places drain it much more slowly, and anywhere else uses a middle rate.
